column4: B longs into a steady ask-stack/bid-withdraw slide and is ~17 ticks underwater by A; A shorts just after sellers swept the bid and the offer reset lower.
B is a long entered as the 12-lot bid is cancelled down to 2 while the offer stacks to 13 lots/10 orders after a seller burst; A shorts a quiet drifting-lower book.

B is a long in a sustained lift: buyers repeatedly take the offer, bid ratchets 3.7885->3.7915 with 15 lots/5 orders behind it, while A shorts a book whose bid adds outnumber cancels and whose offer is being pulled.

At A the offer at 5.1615 is a reloading 8-12 lot wall in 2-3 orders that absorbs every buy while the bid runs 1 lot and price grinds down, so the long is capped and B short from 5 ticks higher is the one working.
A is a long into a fading bid (cancels only, offer stacking) and price is 13 ticks lower by B; B shorts the bounce inside that decline.
B longs as the 9-11 lot offer at 4.9265 is repeatedly cancelled away with buyers lifting, and price is 21 ticks higher by the time A shorts it.
A longs into the last aggression being a seller hitting the bid with the 10-lot/8-order offer intact and price stepping down; B shorts a dead but slightly heavier-offer book that then drifts lower.
A shorts with continuous sell aggression (S11/18 then S3/9, 39 then 16 bid cancels, zero buy prints in the last 4s) and a withdrawing bid; B longs immediately after a 26-lot seller hit the bid.
A shorts into a steady up-grind where the offer is pulled every second (14-19 ask cancels/s) and buyers keep printing; B longs with that trend on a 1-lot offer.
B longs a bid that reloads at 4.6165 (11-13 orders, repeated re-adds) while 24 ask cancels clear the offer and buyers take 15 lots; price is 6 ticks higher when A shorts a chopping book.
Both books are near-dead; B longs after the offer stack thins but price is 4 ticks lower 83s later, while A shorts into a bid that keeps cancelling down (38195->38190).
No trades in either window; B longs under a 7-13 lot offer wall at 32845 with a 2-lot bid, and the bid then cancels down step by step into A, which shorts with that drift.
A shorts as the bid is cancelled to 1 lot and the offer resets lower each second in a one-way 30-point slide; B buys the knife 30 seconds later at the lows with zero prints and a 4x1-lot bid.
Same price at both legs; B longs on a flickering 1-lot bid with four sell prints and no buy prints in the last 10s, while A shorts a book whose bid quietly cancels away.
B shorts right after a buyer lifted the 39125 offer, the offer above was cancelled down and the bid stepped up; A longs the same dead book one tick lower with a 5-order bid.
Opening quote-only book: the lone offer is modified steadily downward (39070->39050) against B long, and 16s later the whole quote is 20-30 points lower where A shorts.

At A the 40455 offer is cancelled away and the bid steps up 40445->40450 on new adds; at B the lone 40450 offer is again pulled, so both books show sellers withdrawing and the long is the side working.
Same price at both legs, but A longs as the 38015 offer is cancelled away order by order and the 38010 bid rebuilds, and B shorts exactly as two buy prints consume the fresh 38015 offer.
B shorts as the 37940 offer is cancelled away and the bid rebuilds; 99s later price is two ticks higher and A longs a bid stacking to 6 lots/5 orders after a buyer cleared the 37950 offer.
Near-identical dead books; B shorts the higher quote and price is already two ticks lower when A longs the same structure, with no aggression on either side to override that drift.
